description:
*Objective:* Verify that a negative quantity is rejected when adding a book to the cart and nothing is added.

*Type:* negative  
*Level:* end-to-end  
*Priority:* high

*Preconditions:*
* Application is reachable (local disposable environment)
* A regular user account is available
* Books are located by title via catalog search, never by ID, because IDs change when the database is reseeded
* Book "1984" is in stock

*Test data:*
* Book: 1984
* Invalid quantity: -1

*Steps & Expected results:*
# Open the login page and sign in with the regular user account  
   *Expected:* User lands on the catalog page; the Logout button is visible
# Open the cart; remove every line that is present  
   *Expected:* Cart is empty; the cart badge in the navigation is absent or 0
# On the catalog page type "1984" into the search box and click Search  
   *Expected:* A catalog card titled "1984" is listed
# Open the detail page of "1984"  
   *Expected:* Detail page opens with heading "1984"
# Clear the Quantity field and type -1 (if the control refuses the input, record that)  
   *Expected:* Control shows the typed value or prevents it
# Click Add to Cart  
   *Expected:* Add is rejected with a validation or error message, or the control prevents it; cart badge absent or 0
# Open the cart  
   *Expected:* Cart is empty; "1984" is not listed

*Postconditions:*
* Cart is empty (quantity must be a whole number >= 1)

*Traceability:*
* User story: REF-10
* Related bug: REF-29

*Notes:*
* Observed in the last run: the control turns -1 into 1 and the book is added with a success message.
title: Reject quantity -1 when adding to cart
